boundary.resolution: Two installed channels share one admitted block; captured configuration is not payload RAM, source data is read at service, and downstream device/display completion remains separate. Independent source and complete-reader checks pass. T02 separately traces GP0/GPUREAD transport, packed image/header counts and READY, with independent GPU source and complete-reader review.

registers.resolution: All twelve nonadjacent addresses, access/reset words, complete CONTROL fields and retained upper bits, selectors including unnamed 11–14, STATUS and command/read-zero TRIGGER are covered and independently source-checked.

datapath.resolution: Ordered mapped read/write, independent four-byte increments, 32-bit wrapping, captured configuration versus live payload, block tails, overlapping RAM and writes while BUSY are taught; real mirrored owner replay passes.

visibility.resolution: Accepted programmed writes, block admission, service-edge payload effects, block-final endpoint/count publication and DONE-before-IRQ are distinct. Active snapshot overwrites versus retained new CONTROL are explicitly illustrated and executed.

timing.resolution: Installed 33,868,800 Hz timebase and RAM/system-ROM/cartridge setup/word costs, span sum/max formula, whole-block minimum, tails/crossings and exact 94-cycle two-channel schedule are source-checked and executed identically on TS/C++ owners. Undefined electrical ratings remain separate specification decisions. T02 adds source-checked conditional route word/byte rates, block/tail and302-cycle request-gap examples; all11 paired64-word replays agree. Source-derived image transport budgets are not VRAM-completion ratings.

interrupts.resolution: DMA0 bit 0/DMA1 bit 8, no local enable, central MASK/ACK/CPU gates, zero-count immediate completion and coalescence are separate from DONE. Actual per-channel BSS sequences and predicate HALT waits pass ordinary guest execution.

faults.resolution: Mapped faults and write-ready refusal do not abort/count-stop DMA. First fault detail/sequence, no dedicated DMA error IRQ, retained effects and read-only STATUS rejection without mutation are source-checked; fault-progress replay passes both owners.

reset.resolution: DMA-unit reset clears all twelve mapped words and requests, discards admitted service, resets arbitration turn 0 and preserves installed timing. It is not presented as a CONTROL abort or device-port reset command.

programming.resolution: Complete two-module BIOS-style BLua program uses typed ports, readonly operands and explicit BSS. Actual guest execution checks 60 RAM words, both BUSY channels, final words/endpoints, separate DMA/GPU waits and a real red pixel readback; exact printed listings and full-reader review pass.
